description.value:
Duration constant

A creature that damages your Rig with a melee attack takes 2d6 electricity damage as the charge earths itself through the striking limb. This does not require a reaction and has no daily limit. It does not trigger on damage from ranged attacks, spells, or area effects.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule element performs automatic damage-reflection back at a melee attacker on being hit (this requires a reactive script/macro in Foundry, not a static predicate) -- bucket 5, no clean mechanism found. Compounded by [RIG-GENERIC-AMBIGUOUS] for which entity "the Rig" being struck actually is.
